correctness.rationale: Deleting the common prefix and suffix of two outputs shows duplication positions i<j coincide exactly when x_t=x_(t+h) for i≤t<j. Thus the deficit is the sum of lag-h equality indicators. A selected constraint graph has all-equalities probability q^(−|S|+β(S)); this gives each binomial marginal and zero covariance across distinct lags. For L=k+ell the two edge lengths are ±k modulo L, a graph of g simple cycles of length L/g≥3. The r-th congruence class loses its cycle precisely when n≤L−g+r, and counting the starting vertices of ordinary length k or ell in the full class gives b or a edges respectively. For n≤L the restriction leaves c whole cycles and paths; only the full selection of a cycle changes the forest baseline. This verifies all exponents and the first corrected coefficient, including c=0 and n=ell. At any larger n containing the residue-zero cycle, the same factorial moment includes a strictly positive cycle contribution and no negative differences from the product baseline. No short-range factorization is assumed past L.
